generation.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create a square flat-colour Christmas illustration for an advent calendar mosaic that will be reduced to exactly 45 by 45 cells. A large decorated evergreen Christmas tree on the left, a smaller red cabin with a bright yellow window on the right, a broad white snowy foreground and a dark blue winter sky. A simple yellow star tops the tree. Tree dominant, cabin secondary, both comfortably inside frame. Use bold stepped silhouettes, very few large solid shapes, strong contrast, simple pixel-art-inspired composition. Important details should occupy several cells at the final 45-pixel scale. A handful of large ornaments only. No gradients, texture, tiny speckles, text, numbers, grid lines, borders, tile mockups or perspective. Flat artwork fills the square. Use these exact colours as a guide (downstream code enforces them): White #FFFFFF, Black #07111B, Blue #01004E, Light blue #005EA3, Green #004417, Lime green #568A00, Yellow #B09100, Orange #B54600, Red #7B010D, Pink #AC436C, Purple #060145, Grey #2E3436, Brown #2D1912.
